scope.baseline: Current source snapshot with only three rendering/indexing files restored to HEAD
scope.note: Background Google conversion/cache changes are present in both builds and are not measured by the synthetic UI fixture.

fixture.time_zone_policy: Convert local date-times using TimeZone.currentSystemDefault() once at fixture initialization; keep the device zone fixed within a comparison.
fixture.current_date_policy: The selected date/month are fixed; the application's live today/clock behavior is unchanged. Do not use Today during this workload.
fixture.repository_policy: ViewModels/repositories still initialize; their calendar UI data is replaced by a fixed CalendarUiState.

build.compilation: cmd package compile -m speed -f after each install

workload.scope: Synthetic local rendering only; no live Google sync; first and last page changes verified from accessibility hierarchy.

month.capture_order: Recorded device UTC start order: before-1, after-1, after-2, before-2, before-3, after-3. Randomization is not recorded.

day.capture_order: Recorded device UTC start order: before-1, after-1, after-2, before-2, before-3, after-3. Randomization is not recorded.

limitations: Three repetitions on one device; interleaved build groups, not randomized.
Frame percentiles are medians of per-run percentiles, not pooled distributions.
Actual FrameTimeline durations are not FPS; Self Jank and App Deadline Missed are Perfetto tags.
Tracing and accessibility inspection add overhead to both builds.
Global thermal status was zero at recorded boundaries, but several local sensors had status 1; this does not prove absence of all thermal effects.
No iPhone frame-pacing claim follows from Android measurements.

month_animation_followup.description: Removal of per-date/per-event shared transition modifiers from Month only, compared with the prior updated build. Caller visibility arguments removed; scene fade retained.
